name: default
description: Common required semantic review checks for e2e-dev-workflow R1/R2/R3 reviews.

common_issues.title: Acceptance criteria are not fully mapped to tests and code.
Affected services or modules are asserted without evidence.
Reviewer findings are approved without required rework routing.
Completion evidence uses generic status text instead of concrete code/test proof.

design.title: Acceptance criteria completeness
design.description: Check that goals, non-goals, use cases, acceptance criteria, data/API effects, and resolved questions are explicit enough for implementation.

design.title: Affected service/module impact evidence
design.description: Verify that affected services, modules, contracts, routes, topics, and downstream dependencies are backed by GitNexus/scanner evidence or clearly marked non-applicable.

design.title: Security-sensitive paths identified
design.description: Identify authorization, authentication, tenant boundary, sensitive data, and abuse/failure paths that must be tested or explicitly ruled out.

test.title: Happy and failure path test depth
test.description: Confirm red tests cover meaningful success behavior plus failure, edge, validation, and regression paths instead of only smoke-level execution.

test.title: HTTP/DMQ contract test coverage
test.description: Check that HTTP and DMQ contracts have producer/consumer expectations, topic/tag/group details, and tests, or a documented non-applicability reason.

test.title: Security negative path coverage
test.description: Confirm authorization, authentication, validation, tenant isolation, and sensitive-data negative paths are tested when the feature touches them.

implementation.title: Acceptance criteria code path trace
implementation.description: For each acceptance criterion, trace the concrete runtime path from entry point through service/repository/client/sender to the response, persistence change, or emitted event.

implementation.title: Implementation completeness
implementation.description: Verify all acceptance criteria, required artifacts, migrations/config, service ownership, and manifest rows use concrete code/test evidence or explicit approved deferral.

implementation.title: Security-sensitive paths implemented and tested
implementation.description: Check that security-sensitive paths found during design/test review are implemented, tested, and not bypassed by local shortcuts.

implementation.title: Project pattern consistency
implementation.description: Compare implementation against existing project patterns for layering, transactions, DTO mapping, error handling, naming, and dependency direction.
